1879048831.name: a melee attack
1879048831.desc: Auto-attack when wielding only a single one-handed weapon.

1879060863.name: Greater Anthem II - War
1879060863.desc: Anthem: Increases Ranged and Tactical Damage of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 2 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879064191.name: Greater Anthem III - Prowess
1879064191.desc: Anthem: Increases Melee Damage Attack Speed, and Orc-craft and Fell-wrought Mitigation of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 2 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879109119.name: Flurry of Words
1879109119.desc: A flurry of chilling words unleashes a swirl of numbing cold on foes around you. An area around you is filled with a flurry of frost, and dealing damage over time.

1879111679.name: Wizard's Fire
1879111679.desc: A basic sigil which burns your foe over a brief time and restores your Power.

conditionalEffects.description: Wild Sigils:\nWizards Sigils will encourage your pets, tiering up different buffs for each element.\n

After using a Lightning Skill, your Frost Skills will slow enemies.

After using a Fire Skill, your Frost Skills will make enemies Brittle, increasing their incoming Critical Chance.
Wizard's Fire burns enemies around your target.

procEffects.description: DNT - Wild Sigils reduce the active cooldown of Sign of the Wild: Rage

1879198335.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Snowcrest-eagle)
1879198335.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879214591.name: Boar's Rush
1879214591.desc: A fast shield rush deals significant damage to enemies in front of you.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879215871.name: Blade-brother
1879215871.desc: A toggle marking an ally as your Blade-brother, making them the target of some of your abilities.\n\nThis skill will prevent the use of Stand Alone while active.

1879222015.name: Nature's Gift
1879222015.desc: This skill brings Nature's Gift to all around the Spirit restoring morale.

1879240703.name: Horn Blast
1879240703.desc: The Champion uses his battle-horn to drive fear into the hearts of his enemies and their steeds.

1879248383.name: Establishing Shot - Light
1879248383.desc: You release a projectile at your target without regard for aim. Though inaccurate, each successful strike with this skill will increase your chance to hit and your chance to score a critical strike against a target. You can gain these benefits up to 5 times. A succssful critical hit will dispel all stacked effects.

1879262847.name: Crippling Shot
1879262847.desc: Seeing your enemy at a distance, you instinctively let loose an arrow, catching your foe off guard. \n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879319167.name: Stowaway Rat
1879319167.desc: Summons a stowaway rat to your side. It once lived on a Corsair ship, but now prefers travelling with you!

1879319935.name: Sacrifice
1879319935.desc: You are able to put yourself in harm's way and absorb all incoming damage, protecting the steed while active.

1879324031.name: Brown Fox
1879324031.desc: Summons a fox to keep you company.

1879334655.name: Blade of the Barrows
1879334655.desc: This blade was forged long ago, and it still remembers that which it was made to do.

1879368191.name: Shield-slam
1879368191.desc: Slams your shield into the foe, interrupting inductions.

1879383551.name: Wanderlust
1879383551.desc: Beornings can assume the form of a bear to travel great distances through the wilderness.

1879409151.name: Decorated Goose
1879409151.desc: Summons a beribboned white goose to keep you company.

1879409279.name: Call Hórin
1879409279.desc: Blow the horn to summon Hórin to your side.

1879415551.name: Extremely Subtle Portent of Vitality
1879415551.desc: A quick burst of vitality, increasing your maximum morale and healing you.

1879440127.name: Gundabad Vanquisher Steed
1879440127.desc: A steed as mysterious and wild as Mount Gundabad

1879466239.name: Motivating Song
1879466239.desc: A simple tune motivate your allies, improving and restoring their morale.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with other sources of Motivate.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Shanties briefly reduce the Damage you receive.
Shanties will restore the morale of affected allies.
Shanties remove one negative effect from each affected ally.

1879467263.name: The Breaking of Thangorodrim
1879467263.desc: Sing a shanty recalling the breaking of Thangorodrim, a tale of the Elder Days that strikes fear into the hearts of your enemies.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with other potent Incoming Damage effects.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Shanties briefly reduce the Damage you receive.
Shanties will restore the morale of affected allies.

1879475967.name: Return to Umbar
1879475967.desc: You're able to quickly return to Umbar Baharbêl. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879489151.name: Bear Hug
1879489151.desc: Your companion throws their bulk at their target, stunning them.

1879508607.name: Tame Hyena
1879508607.desc: Summons a tamed hyena to accompany you on your travels.

1879508735.name: Guide to Ahâba
1879508735.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Ahâba in Idagâl in Mûr Ghala.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879509119.name: Bird in the Hand
1879509119.desc: Hold out your hand for a feathered friend to come and perch on it!

1879516927.name: What's in the Basket?
1879516927.desc: Place a basket. Who can resist looking to see what might be inside?

1879523199.name: The Effigy of The Cursed Rider
1879523199.desc: Summon an effigy of The Cursed Rider, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879525375.name: Willow Fireworks
1879525375.desc: Set off some graceful willow-shaped fireworks!
